parameters.excerpt: For each ``x``INH bit, if the associated privilege mode is not implemented, the bit is read-only zero.
parameters.modal_signal: if the associated privilege mode is not implemented, the bit is read-only zero
parameters.reasoning: The implementation chooses which privilege modes are implemented, which determines whether the corresponding INH bits are read-write or read-only zero. This is a per-bit RW parameter for the INH fields in mhpmevent.

skipped_non_parameters.excerpt: The OF bit is set when the corresponding hpmcounter overflows, and remains set until written by software.
skipped_non_parameters.reason: This describes the fixed behavior of the OF bit - it is always set on overflow and cleared by software write. No implementation choice is involved.

skipped_non_parameters.excerpt: Since hpmcounter values are unsigned values, overflow is defined as unsigned overflow of the implemented counter bits.
skipped_non_parameters.reason: This is a fixed definition of what constitutes overflow - unsigned overflow of counter bits. All implementations must follow this rule.

skipped_non_parameters.excerpt: If an hpmcounter overflows while the associated OF bit is zero, then a "count overflow interrupt request" is generated.
skipped_non_parameters.reason: This describes the fixed interrupt generation behavior that all implementations must follow when OF=0 and overflow occurs.

skipped_non_parameters.excerpt: Count overflow never results from writes to the mhpmcounter__n__ or mhpmevent__n__ registers, only from hardware increments of counter registers.
skipped_non_parameters.reason: This is a fixed requirement ('never results from writes') that applies to all implementations - no implementer choice.
